meta.source: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, U.S. Census Bureau (summary file tables). Tract boundaries: Census TIGER/Line 2017 (2010 tracts) and 2024 (2020 tracts). County: Cuyahoga County, Ohio (FIPS 39035).

reliability_classes.label: Zero estimate
reliability_classes.rule: estimate is zero, so a coefficient of variation is undefined

reliability_classes.label: No MOE
reliability_classes.rule: an estimate exists but the Census Bureau published no margin of error

reliability_classes.label: Unavailable
reliability_classes.rule: estimate suppressed, censored or not computable

meta.dollars_note: Dollar indicators are in the dollars of each vintage end year (nominal), not inflation adjusted.

indicators.name: Adults with a bachelors degree or more
indicators.definition: People 25 and over with a bachelors, masters, professional or doctoral degree divided by people 25 and over (B15003 lines 22-25 over line 1).

indicators.name: Adults without a high school diploma
indicators.definition: People 25 and over whose highest attainment is below a regular diploma or GED, divided by people 25 and over (B15003 lines 2-16 over line 1).

indicators.name: Single-parent family share
indicators.definition: Family households with own children under 18 headed by a householder with no spouse present, divided by all family households with own children under 18 (B11003 lines 10 and 16 over lines 3, 10 and 16).

indicators.name: Median home value
indicators.definition: B25077 line 1, median value of owner-occupied units, in the dollars of the vintage end year. An adjusted column is provided.

indicators.name: Other vacant units share
indicators.definition: Vacant units classified as other vacant (not for rent, for sale, seasonal or sold; often long-term abandoned) divided by all housing units (B25004 line 8 over B25002 line 1).

indicators.name: Rent burden (30 percent or more)
indicators.definition: Renter households paying 30 percent or more of income on gross rent, divided by renter households with a computed rent share (B25070 lines 7-10 over lines 2-10).

indicators.name: Severe rent burden (50 percent or more)
indicators.definition: Renter households paying 50 percent or more of income on gross rent over renter households with a computed rent share (B25070 line 10 over lines 2-10).

indicators.name: Renter-occupied share
indicators.definition: Renter-occupied housing units divided by occupied housing units (B25003 line 3 over line 1).

indicators.name: Housing vacancy rate
indicators.definition: Vacant housing units divided by all housing units (B25002 line 3 over line 1).

indicators.name: Median household income
indicators.definition: B19013 line 1, in the dollars of the vintage end year. A column expressed in 2024 dollars with CPI-U is also provided.

indicators.name: Poverty rate
indicators.definition: People with income in the past 12 months below the federal poverty level divided by people for whom poverty status is determined (B17001 line 2 over line 1).

indicators.name: Households without a vehicle
indicators.definition: Occupied housing units with no vehicle available divided by occupied housing units (B25044 lines 3 and 10 over line 1).

indicators.name: Median age
indicators.definition: B01002 line 1: median age, both sexes.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate
indicators.definition: Unemployed civilians divided by the civilian labor force (B23025 line 5 over line 3).

dictionary.description: Indicator estimate. Rates are percent (0 to 100), counts are people or households, medians are in the unit shown for the indicator.
90 percent margin of error of the value, in the same unit, derived with the Census Bureau ACS handbook formulas for sums and proportions.
Coefficient of variation = (MOE / 1.645) / value. Used to classify reliability. Not exported per tract to keep the file small.
Class from the CV: high below 0.15, medium 0.15 to 0.30, low above 0.30, plus zero_estimate, no_moe and unavailable.
11 character census tract identifier: state (2), county (3), tract (6). Identifiers are only comparable within one tract geography (2010 or 2020).
Array [value, moe, reliability]. JSON null means the value or margin of error is not available.
